privacy.headline: Privacy Policy
body: This preview policy explains the tools on this website. It is a draft pending business review, including retention periods and applicable privacy requirements.

Contacting the business: if you call or email Swenzy Logistics, the information you share can be used to respond to your inquiry. Do not send financial details, government identifiers or other sensitive information.

Website form: lead delivery is currently disabled. Completing this form does not send a lead. When configured and approved, a Red Spectrum server will store the contact and shipment information you choose to submit, then notify the appropriate recipient. During an authorized internal test, notifications go only to Red Spectrum’s confirmed test inbox, not the business.

AI assistant: the Myndy widget is embedded on Swenzy pages. Loading it connects your browser to Myndy; messages or voice interactions you choose to initiate may be processed by Myndy. AI responses may be inaccurate and do not confirm a quote, booking or availability. Do not share sensitive information. The website preview does not imply that the provider agent’s knowledge has been approved.

Technical data: website hosting and third-party services may process connection information needed to serve the website and widget. No separate marketing analytics or advertising tags have been added to this customer website.
Questions: contact rs@swenzylogistics.net with privacy questions or requests. Specific retention periods and handling procedures must be confirmed by the business before launch.
